result.reason: The added ownership clause reaches the preferred position: the Company owns the Site, deliverables, work product, Content and customer data; HDI expressly assigns relevant rights; HDI retains its pre-existing tools and know-how while granting a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for embedded materials; and joint ownership is expressly excluded. The change is confined to the missing IP/data ownership terms and does not disturb the existing operational provisions. Drafting is generally professional, though it could more precisely define “Customer Data” and clarify that the assignment applies only to rights HDI owns or acquires.
